product_info.name: Vanguarda.IA
product_info.type: SaaS B2B Marketing Agency Platform & AI Dashboard
product_info.theme: Dark Mode Sophisticated & High-Density Tactical Tech

design_philosophy.archetype: Performance Pro x Old Money Tech
design_philosophy.vibe: Deep Obsidian background with refined gold/emerald/violet accents, high-contrast typography, dense data visualization, and seamless AI co-pilot workflow
core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Swiss grid precision combined with dark obsidian glass surfaces and tactical neon status indicators
Emotion First: Power, authority, intelligence, and frictionless speed for agency operators
Content is King: Dynamic AI-generated marketing creatives, live Meta Ads pilots, and brand knowledge bases ('Bíblia')
Negative Space & Dense Grids: 1px crisp borders with generous micro-padding to avoid visual clutter

mono_code.use_cases: KPI metrics, AI token consumption, prompt engineering inputs, model selection chips, Meta Ads IDs

layout_and_spacing.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density Data)
layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 fixed left-0 top-0 h-screen border-r border-slate-800 bg-[#0C0D13] z-40
layout_and_spacing.header: sticky top-0 z-30 h-16 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#090A0F]/80 border-b border-slate-800/60 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border border-slate-800/80 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50
visual_enhancers.glowing_borders: relative overflow-hidden before:absolute before:inset-0 before:p-[1px] before:bg-gradient-to-r before:from-indigo-500/40 before:via-violet-500/10 before:to-transparent before:rounded-xl
visual_enhancers.card_hover: transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-0.5 hover:border-slate-700 hover:shadow-lg hover:shadow-indigo-500/5

component_guidelines.dashboard_kpi_cards: Minimalist cardless or 1px stroke containers with delta growth tags, sparklines (Recharts area charts with gradient fill), and high-contrast numbers.
component_guidelines.ai_generator: Split-view interactive panel: left sidebar with parameter controls (Client dropdown, AI model toggle GPT-5.4 / Claude, Prompt formula, image generation toggle, tone of voice slider) and right live preview sandbox (Instagram post mockup, Stories mockup, LinkedIn ad mockup).
component_guidelines.knowledge_base_biblia: Two tabs: Document Management (PDFs, Brand Personas, Guidelines upload) and AI Semantic Q&A (instant chat asking queries across uploaded agency knowledge with source citation chips).
component_guidelines.campaigns_meta_ads: Table and grid switcher with status tags (Ativa, Pausada, Em Análise), visual ROAS dial, daily spend breakdown, and 'Sincronizar Meta Ads' pilot mock trigger.
component_guidelines.clients_crud: Grid of agency client cards with brand logo, assigned account manager, active campaigns count, and quick 'Gerar Peça' shortcut button.
component_guidelines.logs_and_alerts: Live timeline feed with activity filter tags (Geração IA, Erro API, Novo Cliente, Meta Ads Sync) and system health status indicators.
component_guidelines.admin_settings: Tabs for Model Defaults, API Keys, Team Permissions, and Agency Branding (Logo, Custom Subdomain).
component_guidelines.subscription_pricing: 3 tier plans (Starter Agência, Pro Scale, Enterprise White-label) with billing toggle (Mensal/Anual), feature matrices, and Stripe checkout modal trigger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the application UI is fully in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR).
Maintain high-contrast dark mode aesthetic (#090A0F background with slate/indigo cards).

All main views MUST be reachable via the sidebar navigation: Dashboard, Clientes, Geração de Peças, Bíblia (Conhecimento), Campanhas (Meta Ads), Logs & Alertas, Configurações Admin, Planos & Assinatura.
Include model selector dropdown with explicit support for GPT-5.4 Mini and Claude Sonnet 4.6.
Include data-testid on every interactive button, input, card, and tab for reliable automation testing.
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) and Recharts for responsive analytics charts.
Integrate sonner for smooth toast feedback on form submit, AI generation, and client creation.

anti_patterns: No generic unstyled HTML select tags - use Radix/Shadcn UI dropdowns
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing_requirement: Every clickable or key data element must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='generate-piece-submit-button').
